content: Yosuwa Pat I Pahe Isileli wali Abanuwahikan
Sauga Isileli gegewel wewel Yolidani hi kalapanet-an haba, he Yehoba iyaka i ba haba Yosuwa elana i ba,
“Bolau elulutega eluwa nuku hilel Isileli ali un maisena ge maisena gamwaliyaa.
Yaka nuku baek elal pat elulutega eluwa nihi aheliya Yolidani ana luwaluwala, toto topowon hi taltalmilila, ge nihi kalivail nihi na nihi teleliya panuwa toto nasi bulina nuku holaviya.”
Inoke Yosuwa bolau elulutega eluwa bolo iyaka i hilel haba un maisena ge maisena gamwaliyaa, i yoga gogonil

ge i baek elal i ba, “Ku na ku lau Yolidani ana luwaluwala Yehoba wala Yabowaine wana Bateli ana Dedewaga awonaa, yaka tomaha pat maisena ona nuku ahe nuku kalivail vevelamiwa, un maisena maisena nihi bwasowan.
Pat bolo o ni panuwahikagila hauna Yehoba i ginol elala. Bwaliga ebo natumiyau nihi nelimiu nihi ba, ‘Pat bolo ya ali sapu ga i ola?’
yaka nuku ba, ‘Valila wewel Yolidani i kekepa sauga Yehoba wana Bateli ana Dedewaga hi kalivai panetan.’ Pat bolo o boda Isileli heyan ge heyan ni panuwahikagil.”

Inoke bolau o hi ginol ola Yosuwa wana baaba. Hi na pat elulutega eluwa hi ahel wewel Yolidani ana luwaluwala, ali gewi i ola un Isileli ali gewi, i ola Yehoba wana baaba Yosuwa elana. Inoke hi kalivail ge hi na hi teli wali abaholaviya.
Yaka pat elulutega eluwa, bolo iyaka hi aheliya Yolidani ana luwaluwala labi toto topowon hi taltalmilila, pat o Yosuwa abwe i pahe. He pat bolo o heliya iyoho to ana siga lan ebe.

He gamagalau etimwawa hi kalapanet haba, yaa topowon bolo Dedewaga hi kalivai hi talmilila Yolidani ana luwaluwala ana siga Yehoba wana baaba gegewena Yosuwa elana Isileli hi ginol haba, i ola ana logugui Mosese i baunan Yosuwa elana.
Inoke abwe gamagalau mataliyaa, Dedewaga ge topowon bolo ana tokaval hi kalapanet al.
Bolau bolo un Lubeni, Gada ge un Manasa awalehina hi lovivina lohaveyan kaiwena ge hi kalapanet gamagalau gegewel awoliyaa, i ola Mosese wana baaba elal.
He ali gewi poti tausan (40,000) te avaliya Yehoba hi kalapanet hi na Yeliko abwabwina elana lohaveyan kaiwena.
Lan o elana Yehoba Yosuwa alana i teli heyan Isileli gegewel mataliyaa, inoke hi awatauwan yawalina ana sauga miminana, i ola valila Mosese hi awatauwan.
He liwanina i ola to. Yehoba i baek Yosuwa elana i ba,
“U baek topowon bolo Bateli ana Dedewaga hi kalivai elal nihi hem Yolidani nihi eguluwai.”
Inoke Yosuwa i baek topowon elal i ba, “Ku hem wewel Yolidani ku eguluwan.”
Yaka topowon bolo Yehoba wana Bateli ana Dedewaga hi kalivai, hi ha Yolidani hi eguluwan. Sauga hi piliha datuwa, inoke wewel i tub sikal ge banata i sani al.
He baliman ana weikena houwan
ana lan elulutega elana te gamagalau Yolidani hi kalapanet-an. Yaka hi na hi holaviya panuwa Gilgal, Yeliko labi leunati.
Pat elulutega eluwa bolo hi aheliya wewel Yolidani gamwanaa Yosuwa i pahe panuwa o elana.
Inoke i baek boda Isileli elal i ba, “Bwaliga ebo tubutubumiyau nihi nelimiu nihi ba, ‘Pat bolo ya ali sapu ga i ola?’
yaka nuku baek elal nuku ba, ‘Yolidani wewelina i kekepa, inoke bilibili kekevana elana Isileli hi kalapanet.’
Nuku ba ola o, kaiwena Yehoba wala Yabowaine Yolidani wewelina i pakekepa kaiwemiu ana siga ku kalapanet-an, i ola valila Hoga Keketina i pakekepa kaiwema, ana siga ha kalapanet-an.
I ginol ola o inoke gamagalau gegewel panayawiya nihi atena Yehoba iya Togasisi, ge komiu Yehoba wami Yabowaine nuku awatauwan sauga gegewena.”

footnotes.text: Heliya Isileli wali kalenda elana waikena houwan alana Abib, kila wala kalenda eliyana i telipunaa Mat gamwanaa i na ana siga Eipul gamwanaa.
